highlights.title: U.N. Live Updates: Abbas Criticizes Israeli Attacks and Failure of Gaza Peace Plan
highlights.summary: The Palestinian leader, Mahmoud Abbas, condemned settler violence in the West Bank, saying, ‘We will not leave our homeland.’ Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu of Israel will take the stage later today, weeks before pivotal elections at home.
